emma (AE): Heads-up 7: HarborTrust wants a 10-day POC. Must-haves: IdP SAML + SCIM provisioning (users + groups), SCIM group-to-role mapping, strict EU-only residency, customer KMS if possible, audit export for compliance. Also need hosted vs dedicated cost comparison and whether we can accept org-verified domain proofing. They've started the security questionnaire. Can we triage?

sam (SE): Quick notes: we support SAML SP & IdP flow. Metadata endpoint pattern: https://redwood.api/saml/meta/<org-id>. SCIM v2 supported, bulk replace + incremental patch. We need to confirm whether they need group-to-role population on create vs on-login.

li (Security): EU-only residency: hosted EU region available but not full physical isolation guarantees. If they require exclusive infrastructure + customer KMS, that's Private. KMS w/CMK = Private only. Audit logs: we can stream events to their S3/Blob or push to SIEM via webhook; retention tiers are configurable but must be enabled on the account.

nina (Solutions Eng): Pricing snapshot for POC (very rough): Hosted trial: up to 7M tokens/day ~ $2.5k/day incl. credits; Dedicated trial: requires short-term reserved capacity (min 1 month) estimate $35k/month but much cheaper per-token after. If Private required add enterprise license + infra onboarding cost. I'll put a short table. Need expected concurrency, avg seq len.

harbor-iam: We're on Okta. Prefer IdP-initiated SSO. SCIM should push groups and we need mapping: scim.group.displayName -> app.role. Domain verification: we can do org-verified claim from Okta or DNS TXT. KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys.

sam (SE): Okta is fine. For role mapping we accept an uploaded JSON mapping file during POC, e.g. [{"group":"platform","role":"platform_eng"},{"group":"ops","role":"oncall"}]. We can also use the SCIM memberOf attribute if they want realtime sync.

li (Security): For the questionnaire: flagging items that force Private: KMS ownership, full physical isolation, on-prem data storage. Items we can answer for hosted: TLS in transit, at-rest encryption (provider keys), SOC2 controls, vulnerability scanning cadence. I'll draft answers for sections 3/4/7.

harry (SRE): Audit export: I can enable event-export to their Azure storage during the POC. Will need their storage container + SAS token or CIAM role. Also can increase log retention to 90 days for the trial.

nina (Solutions Eng): Action items: 1) sam - generate Okta SAML metadata + sample SCIM mapping. 2) harry - prep audit export playbook + required creds. 3) li - mark questionnaire items that require Private and draft text for hosted answers. 4) me - assemble pricing scenarios and include delta for KMS/Private. Target: deliver pack by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Created TASK-9987 "HarborTrust POC: SAML/SCIM/KMS check" (assignee: sam).

sam (SE): I'll upload metadata + mapping before lunch. Sample mapping inline: [{"group":"platform","role":"platform_eng"},{"group":"ops","role":"oncall"}]

harbor-iam: Thanks all. We'll provide Okta metadata and storage details by COB. Also need a short tech contact: iam-team@harbortrust.com.

emma (AE): Perfect. If anything blocks legal/compliance escalate to me. :raised_hands:
